meta.title: What Does Not Migrate: Export It or Lose It

views.label: Every source-only asset, in one register
views.note: Audit logs, query history, lineage, job run history, and more all live only in the source system tables.

views.label: Exported survives, un-exported does not
views.note: Once the source is decommissioned, anything not deliberately cloned to durable storage is gone for good.

cards.title: This is a register, not a checklist item
items: Audit logs, query history, table lineage, and billing usage all live only in system tables -- clone before decommission
Notebook revision history and Delta table time travel are lost the moment the source workspace or metastore is gone
Personal access tokens, workspace ACLs, and dashboard subscriptions all need explicit export, not a passive assumption

cards.title: One clock nobody controls
items: Job run history is automatically removed after 60 days -- recreated jobs start at zero regardless of export status
That window expires whether or not you have exported it -- export via the Jobs API to Delta on a schedule, not as a one-time task

cards.title: The four that hurt most when missed
items: Delta Sharing recipient activation needs partner communication 2-4 weeks ahead -- nothing to export, only to plan
Key Vault-backed secrets cannot be exported at all -- re-source from the system of record and rotate
DBFS root is not migratable as a unit -- drain it to Volumes or external locations before cutover
